record.original_question: What is the complexity of solving $(n,0,l,kappa)$ linear systems, and how is this affected by the model of computation (direct access vs matrix-vector product)?

evidence.quote: What is the complexity of solving $(n,0,l,\kappa)$ linear systems, and how is this affected by the model of computation (direct access vs matrix-vector product)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$ be a non-singular matrix with singular values $\sigma_1 \geq \sigma_2 \geq \cdots \geq \sigma_n > 0$. Fix integers $0 \leq l \leq n$ and a real number $\kappa \geq 1$. Say that $A$ is an $(n, 0, l, \kappa)$ matrix (a system with $l$ small singular outliers and no large outliers) if:
- the top $n - l$ singular values are well-conditioned in the sense that $\sigma_1 / \sigma_{n-l} \leq \kappa$, and
- the bottom $l$ singular values $\sigma_{n-l+1}, \ldots, \sigma_n$ may be arbitrarily small (the "small singular outliers").

For $b \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and a target accuracy $\varepsilon > 0$, the $(n, 0, l, \kappa)$ linear-system problem is to compute $\widehat{x} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ with $\|\widehat{x} - A^{-1} b\| \leq \varepsilon \|A^{-1} b\|$.

Consider two computational models:
(i) Direct-access model: an algorithm may read individual entries of $A$ and $b$ at unit cost and perform arithmetic operations.
(ii) Matrix–vector product model: an algorithm may, at unit cost per query, choose a vector $v \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and receive $A v$ (or $A^\top v$), in addition to arithmetic on the returned vectors.

Determine the asymptotic query/arithmetic complexity, as a function of $n$, $l$, $\kappa$, and $\varepsilon$, of solving $(n, 0, l, \kappa)$ linear systems in each of these two models, and quantify the gap (if any) between the two models.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent collection of open questions from a numerical linear algebra workshop. No published resolution was found in available searches; standard results give an O(√κ log(1/ε)) matrix-vector iteration upper bound for the well-conditioned bulk, but the precise dependence on the number l of small singular outliers and the gap between direct-access and matrix-vector models is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Condition number - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: For symmetric positive semi-definite A the best known rate is O(√κ log(1/ε)) iterations, tight if restricted to matrix-vector multiplications.
status_evidence.claim: Standard matrix-vector lower/upper bounds depend on κ but do not address mixed models with small singular outliers.

status_evidence.title: Linear Systems and Eigenvalue Problems: Open Questions from a Simons Workshop
status_evidence.snippet: Open questions in iterative solvers, eigenvalue computation, low-rank approximation, randomized sketching.
status_evidence.claim: The complexity of (n,0,l,κ) linear systems is listed as an open workshop question.
